title: RoomApprovedEvent
description: Realtime notification delivered to a knocking guest upon host approval. Contains a cryptographically signed, short-lived room admission token. Transport: Server-to-client over authenticated WebSocket. Visibility: Knocking guest only.

id.description: Unique event identifier (UUIDv7) for server-side deduplication.

approvedBy.description: User ID of the approving host.

accessToken.description: Short-lived cryptographically signed token presented to the media gateway to join the room stage.

expiresAt.description: Expiry timestamp for the room admission token (typically 60 seconds).
